description: Default capability for the main window: download-manager events and path lookups, the folder picker, and scoped external-URL handling. Opening and revealing downloaded files runs through the native open_downloaded_file / reveal_download_file commands (validated against the session completed-artifact registry), so the opener plugin's unrestricted open-path / reveal-item-in-dir grants are intentionally ABSENT. Every entry maps to a traced frontend call site - see docs/security/tauri-security.md for the permission matrix.
